Class Assessment

java.lang.Object
Assessment
public class Assessment extends Object
The Assessment class serves as an abstract superclass for evaluating orbit and collision risks of space objects.

It provides general methods to compute:

  • Likelihood of an object remaining in orbit
  • Recommended actions based on orbit likelihood
  • Collision risk level
  • Response actions based on collision risk
This class is designed to be extended by specific assessment implementations.

  • Method Details

    • calcOrbLikelyScore

      public String calcOrbLikelyScore(SpaceObject object)
      Calculates the orbit likelihood score for the given SpaceObject.

      The formula used: 

       OrbitScore = exp(-daysOld / 3650) *
              (1 - |longitude - avgLongitude| / 180) *
              (1 + log(conjunctionCount + 1))
      Based on the score, returns one of the following:
      • "Yes" if score > 0.8
      • "Maybe" if 0.4 invalid input: '<' score ≤ 0.8
      • "No" if score ≤ 0.4
      Parameters:
      object - A SpaceObject with fields: daysOld, longitude, avgLongitude, conjuctionCount.
      Returns:
      A string representing orbit likelihood: "Yes", "Maybe", or "No".

    • calcCollRiskScore

      public String calcCollRiskScore(SpaceObject object)
      Calculates the collision risk score for the given SpaceObject using: 
       RiskScore = |longitude - avgLongitude| / (daysOld + 1) * log(conjunctionCount + 1)
      The resulting score is classified as:
      • "Very Low Risk" if score invalid input: '<' 0.05
      • "Low Risk" if 0.05 ≤ score invalid input: '<' 0.2
      • "Moderate Risk" if 0.2 ≤ score invalid input: '<' 1.0
      • "High Risk" if score ≥ 1.0
      Parameters:
      object - A SpaceObject with required fields.
      Returns:
      A string indicating the collision risk level.
